description: International Strategy of Cooperation on Cyberspace (March 1, 2017). Joint strategy issued by China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) and Cyberspace Administration of China (CAC) on March 1, 2017 setting out China's international cyberspace governance doctrine, sovereignty principles, and multilateral norms.
